title: 四根绳子打败机械臂？
title_en: Four Strings Beat a Robot Arm?

segments.zh: A robot that lives on your ceiling
segments.en: 一个住在天花板上的机器人，

segments.zh: just hit number one on Hacker News.
segments.en: 冲上了 Hacker News 第一名。

segments.zh: It costs about eight hundred dollars,
segments.en: 它大约八百美元，

segments.zh: and it can reach almost every spot in a room.
segments.en: 几乎够得着房间里每个角落。

segments.zh: No arm. No wheels.
segments.en: 没有手臂，没有轮子，

segments.zh: Just four strings.
segments.en: 只有四根绳子。

segments.zh: It is called Stringman,
segments.en: 它叫 Stringman（绳子侠），

segments.zh: from a tiny company in North Carolina called Neufangled.
segments.en: 来自北卡罗来纳的小公司 Neufangled。

segments.zh: On Hacker News it pulled in over eight hundred points,
segments.en: Hacker News 上它拿了八百多票，

segments.zh: and the comments exploded.
segments.en: 网友吵翻了。

segments.zh: Today's brain teaser:
segments.en: 今天的烧脑问题：

segments.zh: strings can only pull. So how do they put a robot anywhere?
segments.en: 绳子只能拉，凭啥把机器人送到任何地方？

segments.zh: Meet our hero, Grabby,
segments.en: 认识主角：小抓，

segments.zh: a little gripper hanging in the middle of the room.
segments.en: 吊在房间正中间的抓手。

segments.zh: Four motors sit near the ceiling corners.
segments.en: 天花板四个角各有一台电机，

segments.zh: Each one reels a string in or out.
segments.en: 每台收绳或者放绳。

segments.zh: Think of a puppet,
segments.en: 像提线木偶，

segments.zh: but the puppeteer is four motors.
segments.en: 只不过拉线的是四台电机。

segments.zh: Or a giant claw machine,
segments.en: 或者像一台巨型抓娃娃机，

segments.zh: where the whole room is the box.
segments.en: 整间屋子就是那个箱子。

segments.zh: Twist one: you cannot push with a string.
segments.en: 反转一：绳子推不动东西。

segments.zh: Try it. It just goes floppy.
segments.en: 不信你试试，一推就软了。

segments.zh: So every string has to stay tight,
segments.en: 所以每根绳子都得绷紧，

segments.zh: all the time.
segments.en: 一刻都不能松。

segments.zh: To move left,
segments.en: 想往左走，

segments.zh: the left strings reel in, and the right strings let out.
segments.en: 左边收绳，右边放绳。

segments.zh: To go down,
segments.en: 想往下走，

segments.zh: all four let out together.
segments.en: 四根一起放。

segments.zh: The controller adjusts every string's pull
segments.en: 控制器每秒调好几十次

segments.zh: dozens of times a second.
segments.en: 每根绳子的拉力。

segments.zh: Two cameras on the corners
segments.en: 角上的两台摄像头

segments.zh: watch a marker on the gripper, like a referee.
segments.en: 盯着抓手上的标记，像裁判一样。

segments.zh: That flying camera over a football field?
segments.en: 球场上空飞来飞去的摄像机，

segments.zh: It hangs on cables the same way.
segments.en: 也是这样吊在缆绳上的。

segments.zh: Twist two: strings win on reach.
segments.en: 反转二：比够得着，绳子完胜。

segments.zh: The research arm the maker compares it with reaches seventy five centimeters.
segments.en: 厂家拿来对比的研究用机械臂，只能伸七十五厘米。

segments.zh: That arm sweeps less than one cubic meter.
segments.en: 那条手臂能扫的空间，不到一立方米；

segments.zh: Stringman covers about one hundred forty seven.
segments.en: 绳子侠大约一百四十七立方米。

segments.zh: That arm costs about twenty five hundred dollars,
segments.en: 那条手臂大约两千五百美元，

segments.zh: with seven motors.
segments.en: 要七台电机。

segments.zh: Stringman: four motors,
segments.en: 绳子侠：四台电机，

segments.zh: about eight hundred dollars.
segments.en: 八百美元左右。

segments.zh: Per dollar, the maker says,
segments.en: 厂家算了一下：每花一块钱，

segments.zh: that is about five hundred times more room.
segments.en: 能管的空间多了大约五百倍。

segments.zh: It can lift about two kilograms,
segments.en: 而且它能提大约两公斤，

segments.zh: like a big bottle of water.
segments.en: 像一大瓶水。

segments.zh: Why? An arm has to carry its own heavy elbow.
segments.en: 为啥？手臂得扛着自己沉重的胳膊肘，

segments.zh: A string weighs almost nothing.
segments.en: 绳子几乎没有重量。

segments.zh: Twist three, the sneakiest:
segments.en: 反转三，最狡猾：

segments.zh: it is strongest in the middle and weakest in the corners.
segments.en: 它在中间最有劲，在角落最没劲。

segments.zh: In the middle, the strings hang almost straight down,
segments.en: 在中间，绳子几乎竖直往下，

segments.zh: so all their pull holds up the load.
segments.en: 力气全用来拎东西。

segments.zh: Near a wall, the strings lie almost flat,
segments.en: 靠近墙边，绳子快躺平了，

segments.zh: and most of the pull goes sideways, wasted.
segments.en: 大部分力气都往旁边白费了。

segments.zh: It is like two friends carrying a bag by its handles.
segments.en: 就像两个人一人拎一个提手提袋子：

segments.zh: Walk close, easy. Walk far apart, ouch.
segments.en: 挨着走，轻松；离远了，手疼。

segments.zh: For safety, each string is capped at twenty eight newtons,
segments.en: 为了安全，每根绳子最多拉二十八牛，

segments.zh: about the weight of a three kilogram bag.
segments.en: 差不多三公斤东西的重量。

segments.zh: So the corners of the room
segments.en: 所以房间的角落，

segments.zh: are where it struggles most.
segments.en: 就是它最吃力的地方。

segments.zh: Its brain runs on your own computer,
segments.en: 大脑跑在你自己的电脑上，

segments.zh: and the maker says no data leaves your home.
segments.en: 厂家说，数据不出家门。

segments.zh: You teach it a chore by showing it.
segments.en: 你做几遍给它看，它就能学；

segments.zh: The maker says fifty demos can be enough for some tasks.
segments.en: 厂家说有些活五十次示范就够。

segments.zh: Fine print: these numbers come from the maker,
segments.en: 友情提示：这些数字都来自厂家，

segments.zh: and nobody has tested them in your messy living room.
segments.en: 还没人在你家乱糟糟的客厅里测过。

segments.zh: Also, four strings across your living room?
segments.en: 还有，客厅里拉四根绳子，

segments.zh: Your cat may have opinions.
segments.en: 你家的猫可能有意见。

segments.zh: So how do strings that only pull
segments.en: 所以，只能拉的绳子，

segments.zh: put a robot anywhere?
segments.en: 凭啥把机器人送到任何地方？

segments.zh: Four of them play tug of war,
segments.en: 四根绳子互相拔河，

segments.zh: and the robot sits right where the pulls balance.
segments.en: 机器人就停在力量平衡的那一点。

segments.zh: Sometimes the best robot arm
segments.en: 有时候最聪明的机械臂，

segments.zh: is no arm at all.
segments.en: 就是根本没有手臂。
